onboarding.intro: Let's start by personalizing your space. How should we address you?
onboarding.displayNameHelp: This is how your team and friends will see you.

spaces.title: Shared
spaces.intro: Create spaces to share files with your colleagues and peers.
spaces.emptyNoSpacesHint: Create one or join with an invite code.
spaces.emptyNoFavoritesHint: Open a space and choose Add to Favorites from the menu to pin it here.

space.filesErrorHint: The file list took too long to load. This can happen while files are still syncing or a peer is offline.
space.emptyFiles: No files shared yet. Drop files in the sidebar to get started.
space.emptyShareSubtitle: Drag files or folders into the share area on the right to start sharing with this space.
space.emptyMembers: No members connected yet. Share the invite code to get started.
space.creatorDivergenceWarning: The owner identity for this space is in conflict — a peer asserted a different owner than the one on record. Approvals are paused; verify with someone you trust before sharing anything sensitive.
space.approveBlockedDivergence: Approvals are paused while the owner identity conflict is unresolved.
space.joinRequestsDesc: Approve people to give them access to this space.
space.waitingApprovalHint: A member of this space needs to approve you. You can leave this open — you'll be let in automatically as soon as someone's online.

scanPreview.uploadDetail: {{size}} will be added to the space.
scanPreview.conflictDetail: Files at the destination differ from the share. Your existing files are kept; the share's versions are saved alongside with a numbered name.
scanPreview.existingAtDestinationDetail: Anything already in this folder is left in place.

mirrorFolder.title: Mirror “{{name}}” to Disk
mirrorFolder.description: A read-only copy of {{owner}}'s folder will be kept in sync at the location you pick.
mirrorFolder.readOnlyWarning: Read-only. Files you edit here will be reverted to {{owner}}'s version on the next sync.

deleteFolder.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteFolder.body: Members of {{space}} will no longer see this folder.
deleteFolder.filesStay: Files in {{path}} stay on your disk.

addFolder.title: Add Folder
addFolder.description: Files in this folder will be visible to all members of {{space}}.
addFolder.nameHelp: How this folder appears to other members.
addFolder.nameCollision: A folder with this name already exists in this space.
addFolder.nameInvalid: Name can't contain slashes, control characters, or be empty.

folder.unavailableOfflineHint: {{owner}} is offline. The folder's files will load once they're back online.
folder.emptyHintMine: Add files to your local folder and they'll show up here automatically.
folder.emptyHintOther: Files will appear here once {{owner}} adds them.
folder.emptyHintOfflineOwner: {{owner}} is offline and no files have been synced from them yet.
folder.offlineBanner: {{owner}} is offline — showing last synced files. Downloads will resume when they're back online.
folder.browseDescription: Browse-only. Click Download on a file to save it locally, or Mirror to disk to keep the whole folder synced.
folder.mirroredDescription: Read-only mirror. Files stay in sync as the owner changes them. Edits here are reverted on the next sync.
folder.mineDescription: You own this folder. Add or remove files in your local folder; changes sync to the space automatically.
folder.sourceMissingBanner: Source folder moved or unavailable. Members still see the last synced version; changes won't sync until you locate it.
folder.emptyHintMissing: Mirall can't find this folder's source on disk. Locate it to resume syncing, or delete the share.
folder.mirrorPausedBanner: Syncing is paused — files won't update until you resume the mirror.

share.mountPointGoneHint: Source folder moved or unavailable — members see the last synced version

file.sourceChangedRestarting: “{{name}}” changed on the sender — restarting the download
file.downloadRemovedByOwner: Download stopped — “{{name}}” was removed by the owner
file.transferDiskFullToast: Not enough disk space for “{{name}}” — free up space, then retry the download
file.transferChecksumToast: “{{name}}” failed the integrity check — download stopped

joinSpace.expiredLink: This invite link has expired. Ask for a new one.

leaveSpace.body: You'll stop syncing with members in this space. Other members can still share files with each other.

removeFile.body: This file will be removed from the space. Members who already downloaded it will keep their copy.

invite.title: Invite to Space
invite.configureDesc: Choose how people join and how long the link lasts, then create it.
invite.readyDesc: Share this link with a colleague or peer to give them access.
invite.infoText: When a colleague or peer joins with this link, they'll be able to see and sync all files shared in this space.
invite.autoNote: Anyone who opens this link joins instantly until {{date}}. After that the link stops working.
invite.reviewNote: People who open this link before {{date}} ask to join — you approve each one.
invite.autoApproveDesc: Anyone with this invite joins instantly, without approval.

storageSettings.title: Storage
storageSettings.intro: View and manage Mirall data usage on this device.
storageSettings.downloadFolderDesc: Where Mirall saves files downloaded from your space members.
storageSettings.infoText: This is the cache Mirall uses to share files with your space members and to receive their shared files. It does not include files saved to your Downloads folder. When you leave a space, its cache is automatically removed.
storageSettings.aboutReclaimable: Reclaimable space builds up when files in shared folders are edited or replaced. Mirall reclaims it automatically once it grows large and the folder is idle — or reclaim a space yourself from its actions menu.
storageSettings.appStorageDesc: Space Mirall uses on this device to share and sync your files. It never keeps a second copy of your files.
storageSettings.sharingIndexDesc: Compact maps of the files you share (never the file contents). Freed automatically when you stop sharing a file.
storageSettings.appDatabaseDesc: Your spaces, members, and sync history.

reclaimSpace.body: This frees about {{size}} by dropping old versions of files you have edited or replaced in this space. Your current files are unaffected.

clearPeerCache.body: This removes all downloaded content from peers in this space. You can re-download anytime they're online. Your own published files are kept.

aboutSettings.title: About
aboutSettings.keyboardShortcutsDesc: See every shortcut at a glance.
aboutSettings.sendFeedbackDesc: Report a problem or share a suggestion.
aboutSettings.updateReady: v{{version}} is available — it will be installed the next time you quit and reopen Mirall.

notificationSettings.eventMemberLeftDesc: A member of one of your spaces disconnects.
notificationSettings.eventTransferCompleteDesc: A file you are receiving has finished downloading.
notificationSettings.eventTransferErrorDesc: A download could not be completed.
notificationSettings.eventTransferPausedDesc: A download paused because the sender went offline.

connectivity.offlineToast: Network connection lost. Mirall is paused.

verdict.healthyBodyIdle: Ready to share. Nobody else is online right now.
verdict.connectingBody: This is taking longer than expected. Check your firewall, VPN, or ISP.
verdict.offlineBody: Mirall is paused until your network returns.

advice.title: Suggestions
advice.osOffline: Your operating system reports no internet connection. Check your Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
advice.firewalled: Your router appears to be blocking inbound UDP. Peers will reach you only via holepunching.
advice.randomizedNat: Your network randomises outbound ports. Direct connections may fail.
advice.symmetricNat: Symmetric NAT detected — connectivity will rely on holepunched paths.
advice.noPublicAddr: Couldn't determine your public IP. Check your internet connection.
advice.smallRoutingTable: Few DHT peers known so far. Bootstrap may still be in progress.
advice.stillBootstrapping: Still joining the DHT — give it a moment.
